correctness.rationale: For q=2k-1 odd, every unscaled full-length RS[k] evaluation subspace lies in the common coordinate-sum-zero hyperplane of dimension 2k-2: all polynomial power sums for j<k vanish. The Grassmann dimension formula forces pair intersections dimension at least 2 and subspace distance at most 2(k-2)=q-3. Permuting evaluation coordinates by inversion x->x^(q-2) gives monomial exponent spans {0,...,k-1} and {0,k-1,k,...,q-2}, whose only common exponents are 0,k-1. As degree <q monomial evaluation vectors are independent, intersection is exactly dimension 2 for every odd prime power q>=5. At q=5, code equality iff affine evaluation relabeling gives exactly (q-2)!=6 code spaces; their dual-normal conic incidence implies pair intersections dimension2 and any triple dimension1. Independent finite-field row reductions confirmed q=5,7,11 inversion dimensions 2 and the full q5 pair/triple profile. These checks supplement the all-odd-prime-power symbolic proof.
residual_risks: Odd prime powers q>=5, unscaled length exactly q, dimension (q+1)/2; no multiplier/shortened/even-characteristic extrapolation.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The RS source works with l>=2k-1, including formal equality l=2k-1, but its positive constructions and greedy bounds are asymptotic for fixed k,l and q tending large. They do not imply a center1 sunflower at q=l=2k-1; a common parity hyperplane prevents it. Standard Grassmann bounds alone only give upper distance, not the sharp inversion equality.
